pairs.question: Quid facitis? quis clamor? qua, dicite, nautae, huc ope perveni? quo me deferre paratis?
pairs.answer: Pone metum, et quos contingere portus ede velis! terra sistere petita.
pairs.derivation: Bacchus (awaking) asks the sailors; Proreus answers. Dropped the mid-utterance framing 'ait' from the question and the framing 'Proreus' / 'dixit' from the answer; stripped the inline verse number 635. The answer responds to 'quo me deferre paratis?' by telling Bacchus to name the port he wants and assuring him the desired land will be his stop. Span ends at 'petita.' (first full stop of the reply); what follows is Bacchus's next turn '"Naxon" ait Liber...', a new utterance.
